coverage_issues: Report 1 failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if all executable packaging files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and found safe.
Implement retry logic for API errors during file audits to prevent incomplete coverage and false inconclusive verdicts.
